description:
On-chain wallet snapshot (EVM chains): contract or EOA, tx count, native
balance, fresh-wallet flag. $0.005 USDC.

address.description: Public EVM wallet or contract address, 0x plus 40 hexadecimal characters; never a seed phrase or private key.

chain.description: Supported EVM chain identifier such as base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon or bsc; support depends on configured RPC providers.

payment.description: Optional base64-encoded x402 payment payload returned by an authorized payment client, not a private key or API token. Omit to receive payment requirements. A successful authorized call may settle a USDC charge; repeated paid calls may charge again.

name: wallet_snapshot
title: Wallet Snapshot
